name: complexity
title_zh: 删掉会连环炸的部件，留能独立坏的
tagline_zh: 写代码、排计划、搭组织，最怕牵一发动全身。它专挑「耦合点」下手——改一处崩三处的地方，直接标出来让你拆。
tagline_en: Code, plans, orgs—worst when one change breaks three things. It hunts coupling points and marks them for you to.
desc_en: Minimize complexity in software, systems, plans, and organizations. Use when designing, implementing, reviewing, debugging, or simplifying anything whose parts interact or fail together.
why_zh: 不按层数或行数评复杂度，只认「故障传播半径」。半径越大越先拆，机制上逼你处理根因，不是表面简化。
why_en: Judges complexity by failure-propagation radius, not line counts. Biggest radius gets cut first—forces root-cause work, not.
limit_zh: 只分析「部件间交互」的复杂度，不碰算法效率、内存占用、UI 易用性。输入得是结构化描述（代码/架构图/流程清单）。
limit_en: Only handles inter-part interaction complexity—not algorithmic cost, memory, or UX. Needs structured input (code, diagrams, process lists); raw.
title_en: Cut parts that fail together; keep ones that fail alone
